title.en: A map of the three statements

summary.zh-TW: 跟著一家腳踏車行和一家花坊，認識損益表、資產負債表與現金流量表各自回答的問題，學會在情境裡選對報表，並看懂「賺到」與「收到」為什麼不一樣。
summary.en: Follow a bicycle shop and a florist to learn which question each of the income statement, balance sheet and statement of cash flows answers, how to pick the right statement in a given situation, and why earning and receiving are not the same thing.
